name.zh: Rhenium Garry's Mod 服务端系统题（五题正式版）

description.en: Five server-authoritative clean-room GMod tasks for Sandbox on gm_flatgrass.
description.zh: 面向 Sandbox/gm_flatgrass 的服务端权威 clean-room GMod 五题。

title.zh: Prop 所有权与配额管理器

summary.en: Build a deterministic ownership registry and authoritative adapter.
summary.zh: 实现确定性所有权 Registry 与服务端 adapter。

brief.en: Own at most two Props and clean disconnected owners after five seconds.
brief.zh: 每名玩家最多两个 Prop，断线五秒后确定清理。

en: [T1-SEM-01] Track authoritative ownership for each entity generation.
[T1-SEM-02] Enforce a two-Prop quota without replacing prior state on rejection.
[T1-SEM-03] Reject stale entity revisions and EntIndex reuse.
[T1-SEM-05] Deduplicate register and remove requests globally.
[T1-TIME-02] Clean disconnected owners exactly at the five-second boundary.
[T1-PERSIST-01] Return sorted detached snapshots.
[T1-PERSIST-03] Persist configuration, generations, cleanup, and replay state.
[T1-LIFE-01] Remove every owned Hook and Timer on idempotent shutdown.
zh: [T1-SEM-01] 按实体 generation 记录服务端权威所有权。
[T1-SEM-02] 强制每人两个 Prop 的配额，拒绝时不替换旧状态。
[T1-SEM-03] 拒绝旧实体 revision 与 EntIndex 复用。
[T1-SEM-05] 在全局范围去重 register/remove 请求。
[T1-TIME-02] 在断线后恰好五秒边界清理 owner。
[T1-PERSIST-01] 返回排序且 detached 的快照。
[T1-PERSIST-03] 持久化配置、generation、清理与重放状态。
[T1-LIFE-01] 幂等关闭时移除全部自有 Hook 与 Timer。

en: [T1-NATIVE-01] Register paired ownership and lifecycle Hooks.
[T1-NATIVE-04] Advance cleanup with one named repeating Timer.
[T1-NATIVE-02] Gate PhysgunPickup, CanTool, CanProperty remover, and delete.
[T1-NATIVE-03] Allocate stable server entity IDs for new Props.
[T1-TRUST-01] Derive owners only from trusted Player bindings.
zh: [T1-NATIVE-01] 成对注册所有权与生命周期 Hook。
[T1-NATIVE-04] 用一个具名重复 Timer 推进清理。
[T1-NATIVE-02] 检查 PhysgunPickup、CanTool、CanProperty remover 与 delete。
[T1-NATIVE-03] 为新 Prop 分配稳定的服务端实体 ID。
[T1-TRUST-01] owner 只能来自可信 Player 绑定。

en: Owners alone can use all four protected modification paths.
Quota and removal retries change counts exactly once.
Entity generations prevent stale authority after index reuse.
Disconnect cleanup and reconnect obey the exact five-second boundary.
Persistence and shutdown preserve behavior and leave no lifecycle residue.
zh: 只有 owner 能使用四个受保护的修改入口。
配额与删除重试只改变一次计数。
实体 generation 防止索引复用后的旧权限。
断线清理与重连遵守精确五秒边界。
持久化与关闭保持行为且不留下生命周期残留。

hidden_cases: first registration increments quota
third prop is rejected without replacing state
register retries are exact and request conflicts fail
remove retries release quota exactly once
revision replacement rejects stale authority
operations and ownership are enforced
disconnect waits strictly below five seconds and cleans at boundary
reconnect before boundary cancels cleanup
time reversal is clamped
snapshot is deterministic and detached
save load round trip preserves request idempotency
shutdown is idempotent and freezes mutations
only the exact public two prop five second options are accepted
malformed saved state is rejected completely
integration_cases: adapter installs required hooks and timer
entity bindings reject malformed logical identity and revision
trusted player binding owns the prop
benchmark identity is independent of EntIndex
all modification entry points reject non-owner
client owner payload cannot override server player
quota rejects and removes third prop
entity removal releases once and revision blocks EntIndex reuse
disconnect cleanup and reconnect use real hooks

title.zh: 分阶段三点 Prop 对齐工具

summary.en: Align a constrained Prop graph from staged three-point frames.
summary.zh: 用分阶段三点坐标系对齐带约束的 Prop 图。

brief.en: A clientless Toolgun workflow with canonical geometry, rollback and Undo.
brief.zh: 实现 clientless Toolgun、规范几何、回滚与 Undo。

en: [T2-SEM-02] Capture six anchors in the exact public stage order.
[T2-GEO-01] Reject degenerate and collinear three-point frames atomically.
[T2-GEO-02] Map probes through source and target orthonormal frames.
[T2-SEM-04] Deduplicate every staged operation in one request namespace.
[T2-SEM-05] Bind sessions to player, entity generation, and a two-operation budget.
[T2-PERSIST-01] Preserve sessions, spent budget, and replay across save/load.
[T2-ROLLBACK-01] Roll back all objects on constraint or Undo failure.
[T2-LIFE-01] Clean all adapter lifecycle state on shutdown.
zh: [T2-SEM-02] 严格按公开的六步顺序采集锚点。
[T2-GEO-01] 原子拒绝退化与共线三点坐标系。
[T2-GEO-02] 通过源和目标正交坐标系映射 probe。
[T2-SEM-04] 在统一 request 命名空间去重所有阶段操作。
[T2-SEM-05] session 绑定玩家、实体 generation 与两次操作预算。
[T2-PERSIST-01] save/load 保留 session、已用预算和重放。
[T2-ROLLBACK-01] constraint 或 Undo 失败时回滚全部本次对象。
[T2-LIFE-01] Shutdown 清理全部 adapter 生命周期状态。

en: [T2-NATIVE-01] Gate every stage through the CanTool Hook.
[T2-NATIVE-02] Convert real traces to plain numeric points.
[T2-NATIVE-03] Create Props and Welds with public APIs.
[T2-NATIVE-05] Register one Undo unit for the whole operation.
[T2-NATIVE-04] Drive LeftClick through real gmod_tool PrimaryAttack and util.TraceLine.
zh: [T2-NATIVE-01] 每个阶段都通过 CanTool Hook 检查。
[T2-NATIVE-02] 把真实 trace 转换为纯数值 point。
[T2-NATIVE-03] 用公开 API 创建 Prop 与 Weld。
[T2-NATIVE-05] 把整个操作登记为一个 Undo 单元。
[T2-NATIVE-04] 通过真实 gmod_tool PrimaryAttack 与 util.TraceLine 驱动 LeftClick。

en: Ordered anchors and quantized geometry produce the required transform.
Authority and entity generations cannot be forged.
Replay, clear, budget, and persistence remain deterministic.
Real Toolgun, trace, constraint, and Undo integration completes one copy.
All failures roll back and shutdown leaves no lifecycle residue.
zh: 顺序锚点与量化几何产生规定的变换。
权限与实体 generation 不可伪造。
重放、clear、预算和持久化保持确定。
真实 Toolgun、trace、constraint 和 Undo 完成一次复制。
所有失败均回滚，关闭后无生命周期残留。

interfaces: alignment:stage(request_id, player_id, entity_id, revision, frame, slot, point)

hidden_cases: six anchors must follow the public stage order

collinear and zero length frames are rejected
canonical output is quantized and detached
player entity and revision bind one staging session
exact request replay is idempotent and conflicts fail

malformed sessions requests and budgets are rejected
integration_cases: adapter installs CanTool lifecycle hooks and timer
trusted player and entity bindings drive six traces
unbound and forged trace identity are rejected
CanTool denial blocks staging before mutation

unknown execution mode is rejected before core mutation
constraint failure rolls back created entities
disconnect clears adapter staging identity
lifecycle_cases: shutdown removes every hook and timer

summary.en: Persist named authoritative weapon and ammo profiles.
summary.zh: 持久化命名的服务端权威武器与弹药配置。

brief.en: Restore canonical loadouts across death, respawn, disconnect and restart.
brief.zh: 跨死亡、重生、断线和重启恢复规范 loadout。

en: [T3-DATA-03] Enforce the closed four-weapon allowlist.
[T3-DATA-04] Enforce Pistol 200, SMG1 120, and Buckshot 32 aggregate caps.
[T3-SEM-01] Limit each player to five profiles and four unique weapons per profile.
[T3-SEM-02] Preserve primary/secondary ammo while producing sorted merged plans.
[T3-SEM-04] Deduplicate put/select requests and reject stale revisions.
[T3-PERSIST-02] Persist profiles, preference, revisions, time, and replay.
[T3-ROLLBACK-01] Stop Apply at the first failed phase.
[T3-LIFE-01] Preserve profiles across disconnect and clean lifecycle state on shutdown.
zh: [T3-DATA-03] 强制封闭的四种武器 allowlist。
[T3-DATA-04] 强制 Pistol 200、SMG1 120、Buckshot 32 的聚合上限。
[T3-SEM-01] 每玩家最多五个 profile，每 profile 最多四把不同武器。
[T3-SEM-02] 保留 primary/secondary 弹药并生成排序合并计划。
[T3-SEM-04] 去重 put/select 请求并拒绝旧 revision。
[T3-PERSIST-02] 持久化 profile、偏好、revision、时间与重放。
[T3-ROLLBACK-01] Apply 在第一个失败阶段立即停止。
[T3-LIFE-01] 断线保留 profile，Shutdown 清理生命周期状态。

en: [T3-NATIVE-01] Strip weapons before every Apply.
[T3-NATIVE-03] Remove all ammunition before granting the canonical plan.
[T3-NATIVE-04] Give sorted weapons and merged ammo through Player APIs.
[T3-NATIVE-05] Select the first successfully granted weapon.
[T3-NATIVE-02] Restore through real PlayerSpawn and paired lifecycle Hooks.
zh: [T3-NATIVE-01] 每次 Apply 先 StripWeapons。
[T3-NATIVE-03] 发放规范计划前 RemoveAllAmmo。
[T3-NATIVE-04] 通过 Player API 发放排序武器与合并弹药。
[T3-NATIVE-05] 选择第一把成功发放的武器。
[T3-NATIVE-02] 通过真实 PlayerSpawn 与成对生命周期 Hook 恢复。

en: Profile limits, closed allowlists, and exact ammo caps are enforced.
Primary and secondary ammo merge once into detached sorted plans.
Replay, revisions, disconnect, and two-process persistence remain stable.
Real Bot spawn restores weapons and canonical ammunition.
Partial Give stops before ammo and shutdown leaves no lifecycle residue.
zh: Profile 限制、封闭 allowlist 与精确弹药上限均被强制。
Primary/secondary 弹药只合并一次并形成 detached 排序计划。
重放、revision、断线与两进程持久化保持稳定。
真实 Bot 重生恢复武器与规范弹药。
部分 Give 失败会在发弹前停止，关闭后无生命周期残留。

hidden_cases: multiple named profiles and preferred selection
weapon and ammo allowlists reject unknown values
shared ammo is merged once and sorted
ammo caps are checked after aggregation
primary and secondary ammo remain explicit
request retries are exact and conflicts fail
profile and preferred revisions reject stale writes
profile and weapon count limits are enforced
plans and stored profiles are detached
disconnect retains persistent profiles
save load preserves preference revisions and replay
shutdown is idempotent and freezes writes
legal request identifiers freeze parameter and business failures
malformed persisted profiles choices requests and plans are rejected
integration_cases: adapter installs only meaningful spawn and disconnect hooks
trusted binding overrides all payload identity
Apply orders Strip Give Ammo and selection
shared ammo is granted once at the merged amount
spawn hook reapplies without accumulating pickups
partial Give failure stops before ammo
disconnect removes object binding but retains profile
Install is idempotent

summary.en: Order touch events and settle one multiplayer consequence.
summary.zh: 确定排序触碰事件并只结算一次多人后果。

brief.en: Combine a deterministic adapter with real physical StartTouch and Touch.
brief.zh: 组合确定性 adapter 与真实物理 StartTouch/Touch。

en: [T4-SEM-01] Implement the complete five-state round lifecycle.
[T4-SEM-02] Freeze exactly three players, one object generation, variant, and deadline.
[T4-SEM-04] Deduplicate all lifecycle events in one namespace.
[T4-SEM-05] Enforce monotonic touch sequence and exact generations.
[T4-LIFE-01] Reassign a lost holder by stable player identity.
[T4-LIFE-02] Give each respawn a strictly newer player revision.
[T4-TIME-02] Settle exactly once at the deadline boundary.
[T4-PERSIST-02] Persist audit, result, revisions, ordering, and deduplication.
zh: [T4-SEM-01] 实现完整的五状态回合生命周期。
[T4-SEM-02] 冻结恰好三名玩家、一个物体 generation、variant 与 deadline。
[T4-SEM-04] 在统一命名空间去重全部生命周期事件。
[T4-SEM-05] 强制递增 touch sequence 与精确 generation。
[T4-LIFE-01] 按稳定玩家 ID 为失效 holder 选择继任者。
[T4-LIFE-02] 每次 respawn 使用严格更新的玩家 revision。
[T4-TIME-02] 在 deadline 边界恰好结算一次。
[T4-PERSIST-02] 持久化 audit、result、revision、顺序与去重。

en: [T4-NATIVE-01] Register PlayerDeath, PlayerSpawn, PlayerDisconnected, and EntityRemoved Hooks.
[T4-NATIVE-04] Drive deadlines with one named repeating Timer.
[T4-NATIVE-02] Route real entity StartTouch through Dispatch.
[T4-NATIVE-03] Route real entity Touch through the same Dispatch.
[T4-TRUST-01] Bind three real Bots and the object generation on the server.
zh: [T4-NATIVE-01] 注册 PlayerDeath、PlayerSpawn、PlayerDisconnected 与 EntityRemoved Hook。
[T4-NATIVE-04] 用一个具名重复 Timer 推进 deadline。
[T4-NATIVE-02] 将真实实体 StartTouch 接入 Dispatch。
[T4-NATIVE-03] 将真实实体 Touch 接入同一 Dispatch。
[T4-TRUST-01] 在服务端绑定三个真实 Bot 与物体 generation。

en: Both variants and all five states obey the frozen round contract.
Event replay, sequence, generations, and time boundaries are deterministic.
Death, disconnect, respawn, and settlement change authority exactly once.
Three real Bots and physical StartTouch/Touch use the authoritative path.
Two-process persistence and shutdown preserve results without residue.
zh: 两种 variant 与五个状态均遵守冻结回合合同。
事件重放、sequence、generation 与时间边界保持确定。
死亡、断线、重生与结算都只改变一次权威状态。
三个真实 Bot 与物理 StartTouch/Touch 使用权威路径。
两进程持久化与 Shutdown 保留结果且无残留。

interfaces: controller:touch(event_id, object_id, object_revision, player_id, player_revision, sequence, now)

hidden_cases: round starts with three stable players and frozen deadline
monotonic touch sequence transfers holder
event replay is exact and conflicts fail
wrong object generation and dead player never transfer
holder death and disconnect choose stable successor
respawn creates a new player revision
deadline settles exploding round exactly once
infectious variant excludes every infected survivor from winners
time reversal cannot reopen or delay settlement
finished transitions to cleanup without second consequence
save load preserves audit result and deduplication

shutdown is idempotent and freezes events
malformed players events audit result and revisions are rejected
integration_cases: adapter installs lifecycle hooks and one timer
trusted bindings start a three player round
object binding is single use and removal restores original callbacks
entity StartTouch and Touch share deterministic dispatch
unbound physical touch cannot impersonate a player
PlayerDeath hook changes holder once
PlayerSpawn rebinds a new revision
timer reaches fixed deadline exactly once
Save exposes deterministic audit for restart
lifecycle_cases: shutdown removes hooks timer restores callbacks and freezes adapter

summary.en: Canonicalize, persist and restore an entity/constraint graph.
summary.zh: 规范化、持久化并恢复实体/约束图。

brief.en: Use public duplicator, constraint and Undo APIs with full rollback.
brief.zh: 用公开 duplicator、constraint、Undo API 实现全回滚。

en: [T5-DATA-02] Enforce the closed entity class and model allowlists.
[T5-DATA-03] Enforce the Weld/NoCollide constraint allowlist and valid endpoints.
[T5-DATA-04] Enforce budgets of 8 blueprints, 16 entities, and 24 constraints.
[T5-SEM-01] Assign stable local entity IDs independently of input order.
[T5-HASH-01] Produce a behavioral canonical hash from normalized fields.
[T5-SEM-07] Deduplicate capture and paste-plan requests with revisions.
[T5-PERSIST-01] Preserve schemas, requests, and paste results across restart.
[T5-ROLLBACK-01] Roll back every object on partial Paste or Undo failure.
zh: [T5-DATA-02] 强制封闭的实体 class/model allowlist。
[T5-DATA-03] 强制 Weld/NoCollide constraint allowlist 与有效端点。
[T5-DATA-04] 强制 8 blueprint、16 entity、24 constraint 预算。
[T5-SEM-01] 独立于输入顺序分配稳定 local entity ID。
[T5-HASH-01] 从规范字段生成行为定义的 canonical hash。
[T5-SEM-07] 结合 revision 去重 capture 与 paste-plan 请求。
[T5-PERSIST-01] 跨重启保留 schema、request 与 paste 结果。
[T5-ROLLBACK-01] 部分 Paste 或 Undo 失败时回滚全部对象。

en: [T5-NATIVE-01] Capture with public duplicator.Copy.
[T5-NATIVE-02] Inspect constraints with public constraint.GetTable.
[T5-NATIVE-03] Restore with public duplicator.Paste.
[T5-NATIVE-04] Register all restored objects in one Undo unit.
[T5-NATIVE-05] Assign restored Props with cleanup.Add without internal APIs.
zh: [T5-NATIVE-01] 使用公开 duplicator.Copy 捕获。
[T5-NATIVE-02] 使用公开 constraint.GetTable 检查约束。
[T5-NATIVE-03] 使用公开 duplicator.Paste 恢复。
[T5-NATIVE-04] 将全部恢复对象登记为一个 Undo 单元。
[T5-NATIVE-05] 用 cleanup.Add 归属恢复 Prop，不调用内部 API。

en: A real three-node two-edge graph canonicalizes within exact allowlists and budgets.
Malformed graphs fail before mutation and owner views remain detached.
Replay, revisions, paste records, and two-process persistence remain stable.
Public Copy/GetTable/Paste plus one Undo restore and remove the graph.
Partial failures fully roll back and shutdown leaves no lifecycle residue.
zh: 真实三节点两边图在精确 allowlist 与预算内完成规范化。
恶意图在修改前失败，owner 视图保持 detached。
重放、revision、paste 记录与两进程持久化保持稳定。
公开 Copy/GetTable/Paste 与一个 Undo 可恢复并移除图。
部分失败完全回滚，关闭后无生命周期残留。
